protocol.study: Direct CUDA training on the frozen central Bahrain qualifying model

reward.reference: adaptive spread block durations on the corresponding grid
reward.definition: Spread reference block time minus actual block time at every step, with a final penalty of one second per m/s below the common finish target. No action projection, supervision, demonstrations, or extra physical information.

protocol.endpoint: Final deterministic policy on 160 and 320 cells per block for every seed. Train both algorithms at width 64 first, then both at 256 regardless of endpoint feasibility or ranking. Report raw times for infeasible laps only as diagnostics. Report pairwise savings only where both laps are feasible. Use exactly one shared physics transition per interaction; PPO and SAC have different prescribed update schedules and exploration. No checkpoint, hyperparameter, width or seed selection.
protocol.scope: Conditional central-model pilot. All runs start from independent random weights; seed labels pair settings descriptively. No acquisition, model refit, real-car validation, algorithm-general performance, matched wheel-work or convergence claim. Geometry uses a process-local, hash-checked cache; every training physics transition is integrated anew, and SAC samples its own run's host-memory replay buffer.

observations: battery energy above reserve / usable capacity
cache: Provenance is frozen geometry plus phase and grid registered in each worker. Every physics transition is freshly integrated. Each SAC worker has a private host NumPy replay buffer. No cache or policy data crosses workers.

experiment.study: Hard finish-speed constraint on the frozen central Bahrain simulator
experiment.certificate: Use the last three blocks, corresponding to the finish-only reference in the earlier Bahrain search. Compute zero-assist block durations on each grid. Reserve sufficient electrical draw for full power for the entire final three-block duration, with no credit for future recovery. Before that suffix, cap each request by both remaining charge and discharge allowance. In the suffix accept the actor's requested action if exact model lookahead, followed by full request, can meet the original finish speed. Otherwise apply the verified full-request backup. Recheck the physical outcome and abort on an infeasible backup. Do not change physical state, reserve or model.
experiment.reward: Keep the recorded reward, observations, underlying dynamics, 4096 applied steps per seed and optimizer settings. Add the constraint during training and evaluation. Record model lookahead transitions separately from agent interactions. Learn from proposals in the constrained environment.
experiment.comparison: Same seeds 0,1,2, PPO and SAC at actor widths 64 and 256. Archive and cross both training conditions with guard on/off on the 160/320 grids. Run guarded spread/planner and retain raw reference results. Feasibility first. Report time differences only for jointly feasible pairs. Separate runtime enforcement from autonomous learning. No equal-work claim in general controller comparisons.

preflight.purpose: Check physical/accounting/gate parity, exhaustion of both budgets, actual prefix invariants and recoverability on named controls. Record time; fail on physical or numerical inconsistency.

experiment.scope: Central model only, fixed rolling boundary; no new telemetry, manuscript generation or checkpoint selection.
